title: Diesel crunch to sustain high prices, cut demand amid refinery outages
summary:
High diesel prices may elevate transportation costs, impacting goods pricing and economic activity, while fueling crude oil price speculation.
The post Diesel crunch to sustain high prices, cut demand amid refinery outages appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: A tightening diesel market driven by ongoing refinery outages is expected to sustain high prices and reduce overall demand. These elevated costs could increase transportation expenses, influence broader goods pricing, affect economic activity, and stimulate renewed speculation in crude oil markets.

title: Jack Dorsey’s Block seeks OCC approval to establish national trust bank for Bitcoin, stablecoin custody
summary:
Block's move to establish a national trust bank could significantly enhance regulatory clarity and trust in digital asset custody services.
The post Jack Dorsey’s Block seeks OCC approval to establish national trust bank for Bitcoin, stablecoin custody appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Jack Dorsey’s company Block has applied for approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to establish a national trust bank. The proposed institution would focus on custody services for digital assets, including Bitcoin and stablecoins. This strategic move aims to bring greater regulatory clarity and institutional trust to digital asset custody within the financial sector.

title: 90% of the World's Businesses Face the Biggest Hormuz Risk, UN Report Finds
summary:
UN Trade and Development says disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz could push small firms out of global value chains, even after trade volumes recover. The agency calls the danger an exclusion effect. It argues that Hormuz risk lands hardest on companies that cannot spread costs across multiple suppliers, markets, and lenders. Small Firms Carry
The post 90% of the World's Businesses Face the Biggest Hormuz Risk, UN Report Finds appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: A new United Nations Trade and Development report warns that disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz threaten 90 percent of the world's businesses. The agency highlights an exclusion effect, noting that small firms struggling to spread costs across multiple suppliers and markets face severe risks of being pushed out of global value chains.

title: Gemini receives Singapore payment license for crypto services
summary: Gemini’s local entity is authorized to provide digital payment token and cross-border money transfer services without standard transaction-volume limits.
content: Cryptocurrency exchange Gemini has been granted a major payment institution license in Singapore. The authorization allows Gemini’s local entity to provide digital payment token services and cross-border money transfer services without standard transaction-volume limits, strengthening the company's regulatory standing and expansion in the region.

title: Hunter Biden defends LAPTOP ahead of Wednesday launch, calls TRUMP a ‘grift’
summary: Biden says the token is about “resilience, redemption and recovery” and will give coins to nearly one million wallets that lost money on TRUMP.
content: Hunter Biden has defended an upcoming cryptocurrency token launch scheduled for Wednesday, describing it as a project centered on resilience, redemption, and recovery. In comments surrounding the release, Biden also criticized Donald Trump, labeling his ventures a grift. The new digital asset initiative plans to distribute coins to nearly one million digital wallets that previously suffered financial losses linked to Trump-associated tokens.

title: Brent crude nears $100 as yen strengthens on potential Bank of Japan rate hike
summary:
Rising oil prices and a stronger yen could lead to global economic shifts, affecting trade balances and monetary policies worldwide.
The post Brent crude nears $100 as yen strengthens on potential Bank of Japan rate hike appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Brent crude oil prices have moved close to the $100 mark, driven by global market conditions. Concurrently, the Japanese yen has strengthened amid expectations of a potential interest rate hike by the Bank of Japan. These developments could trigger broader economic shifts, impacting international trade balances and monetary policies worldwide.

title: Pi Network’s Protocol 27 Upgrade One Week Away
summary:

Pi Network’s Protocol 27 upgrade is set to launch September 15, just seven days out. Described as the final upgrade in the network’s current development line, Protocol v27 brings enhanced smart contract authentication, giving accounts and applications more sophisticated transaction authorization while expanding the network’s smart contract capabilities. Node operators must upgrade to version 27.1 …
content: Pi Network is scheduled to launch its Protocol 27 upgrade on September 15. Promoted as the final update in the current development phase, Protocol v27 introduces enhanced smart contract authentication. This feature provides accounts and applications with advanced transaction authorization and expands the network's overall capabilities. Node operators are required to update their software to version 27.1 ahead of the release.
